trisuli_rasuwa.name: Upper Trisuli / Rasuwa Gorge
trisuli_rasuwa.subtitle: Mailung–Syafru corridor (249 landslides)
trisuli_rasuwa.description: Deep Himalayan river gorge with steep valley-wall rockfalls and translational slides.

bhote_koshi.name: Bhote Koshi Canyon (Kodari)
bhote_koshi.subtitle: Arniko Highway border gorge (dense cluster)
bhote_koshi.description: Highest spatial density of coseismic landslides in the 2015 Gorkha inventory.

langtang.name: Langtang Valley & Massif
langtang.subtitle: Includes the 1.97 km² Langtang rock-ice avalanche
langtang.description: High-relief glaciated valley containing the largest single landslide in the dataset.

budi_gandaki.name: Budi Gandaki Gorge (Gorkha)
budi_gandaki.subtitle: Near M 7.8 mainshock epicentral zone (Max PGA/MMI)
budi_gandaki.description: Steep incised valley east of Barpak & Laprak in Gorkha District.

rupture_corridor.name: Gorkha–Kodari Regional Corridor
rupture_corridor.subtitle: Wide 3D fault-rupture swath (Major landslides > 25,000 m²)
rupture_corridor.description: Full ground-motion gradient from Barpak epicenter across Langtang to Bhote Koshi.
